Enabled.Name: Auto roll damage
Enabled.Hint: After you roll an attack, damage rolls for you if your rule below is met. This only changes your own rolls.

Trigger.Name: When to roll damage
Trigger.Hint: Pick the rule for your own attacks.

NoTarget.Name: If you have no target picked
NoTarget.Hint: The module needs a target to check armor class. A natural 20 always rolls damage.

ShowDialog.Name: Show the damage dialog
ShowDialog.Hint: Off means damage rolls instantly with no pop up.

ChatNote.Name: Post a short hit or miss note
ChatNote.Hint: Adds one small line in chat, like: Hit on Foreman (19 vs AC 18).

ShowName.Name: Show the attacker name in the note
ShowName.Hint: Off by default. The chat message already shows who is speaking. Turn on to also put the name inside the note.
